editor.description: Can read and write entries and templates

cicd.description: CI/CD pipeline: read templates and entries, build, CUE validate, bulk lookup, resolve non-vault secret values

entrypushd.description: Service account for entrypushd binary (snapshot delivery + HPKE vault delivery)

vault_reader.description: Read vault (passbox) index and resolve its secret values — human counterpart of entrypushd's vault access

vault_operator.description: vault_reader + write entries (body-based: write scope is all prefixes until body-aware authz lands; passbox writes are forced secure by prefix-config)

template_editor_nonprod.description: Read all templates; create/update only in non-production stages (path-scoped); validate against CUE specs

secrets_reader_nonprod.description: Resolve plaintext secret values for every root except beta/production/dr (development/qa/sandbox/global)

templates_publisher.description: Full template operations: read, write (any stage), build, vars, CUE validate

templates_publisher_nonprod.description: Read all templates; write only non-production stages; build, vars, CUE validate

templates_viewer.description: Read-only templates (list, detail, build output, vars)

entries_editor.description: Create/update and read entries one level at a time (no leaves, no lookup)

entries_reader.description: Read all entry index records: by key, prefix (one level), bulk lookup, export (no plaintext, no leaves)

entries_reader_nonprod.description: Read entry index records only for development/qa/sandbox/global, plus change history

security_auditor.description: Read EVERYTHING (templates, entries, non-vault and vault plaintext, history) — zero writes: an auditor observes
